_about: Dealy Hall as one drawn building (decisions/0020). Footprint rows use the map legend (game/world/tiles.py); ' ' leaves the map cell alone, '.' is lawn and ':' walkway. The 'D' on the west side is the columned main entrance, facing Cunniffe House; the 'D' on the east side of the wing is the dining entrance. The tiles only show if map.png is missing; the minimap reads them for colors.
